title: Ungodliness
summary: UNGOD'LINESS, noun Impiety; wickedness; disregard of God and his commands and neglect of his worship; or any positive act of disobedience or irreverence. The wrath of God is revealed from heaven again

inlines.v: UNGOD'LINESS, noun Impiety; wickedness; disregard of God and his commands and neglect of his worship; or any positive act of disobedience or irreverence. The wrath of God is revealed from heaven against all ungodliness Romans 1:18.
